ordered_diagnoses: Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type

facts.raw_span: painful swelling and ulceration of the glans penis of 1 month's duration
elevated white blood cell count and inguinal lymphadenopathy discovered 9 years prior
fatigue, weight loss, and loss of appetite
asymptomatic 'green-yellow welts' and swelling of the glans penis
swelling became progressively painful and evolved to the size of an 'orange' over 4 days
no improvement with topical antibiotics, antifungal agents, hydrogen peroxide soaks, warm compresses, and cephalexin
glans penis and corona were grossly edematous
3.7 × 3.3-cm tender, firm ulcer on the ventral surface of the penis with overlying black eschar, adherent yellow crust, and granulation tissue
no urethral discharge was present
routine blood test results were within normal limits
dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, which were CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+, within the background of a reactive T-cell infiltrate
clonal IgH gene rearrangement

concepts.why: The presence of atypical lymphocytes with specific immunophenotypic markers and a large ulcerative lesion supports the diagnosis of Primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type, but the clonal IgH gene rearrangement is more commonly associated with systemic lymphoma.

rationales.F01: Presence of painful swelling and ulceration of the glans penis suggests a malignant process, which is more typical of Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
rationales.F08: The presence of a tender, firm ulcer on the ventral surface of the penis with overlying black eschar, adherent yellow crust, and granulation tissue is highly suggestive of a malignant process, such as Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
rationales.F11: The dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, which were CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+, within the background of a reactive T-cell infiltrate, is highly suggestive of Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
rationales.F12: The presence of a clonal IgH gene rearrangement is highly suggestive of a B-cell lymphoma, such as Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
